values.note: FAS camping $12/night with a valid fishing license, $18 without (the split is by fishing license, not residency). FWP's 2026 fee table gives $5 / $7.50 for MT residents 62+, disabled or veterans. The page also lists conservation licenses (MT resident $8, senior/youth $4, nonresident $10).

fees.source: https://myfwp.mt.gov/fishMT/fas/39754245 (Facilities & Fees: 'FAS Camping With Valid Fishing License 12.0', 'FAS Camping Without Valid Fishing License 18.0') + https://fwp.mt.gov/binaries/content/assets/fwp/fish/fas/2026-fas-fee-table_adopted.pdf (as previously recorded), read 2026-10-22

values.note: FWP lists a campsite, a toilet (type not stated) and primitive campsites; no drinking water listed. ADA accessibility rated 'Difficult'.

facilities.source: https://myfwp.mt.gov/fishMT/fas/39754245 (Facilities: 'Campsite', 'Toilet', 'Primitive Campsite'; ADA Accessibility 'Difficult Accessibility'), read 2026-10-22

note: Montana FWP fishing access site (14 acres, ~3,650 ft) on the Blackfoot River with designated primitive camping. Directions (FWP): 25.5 miles east of Bonner on Hwy 200, turn west (just before mile marker 27) on Ninemile Prairie Road for 4.2 miles. FWP: 'Access to water is difficult.' --Claude
summary: FWP FishMT page confirms $12/$18 FAS camping, the 25-ft trailer limit (derived -> manual), the 7-day stay limit, toilet and primitive campsites. Year-round season (manual) unchanged. Not stated: site count, toilet type, how sites are taken (derived FCFS left), hookups (derived electric 0 left). Note trimmed of restated facilities, limits, FCFS and fees; FWP's water-access caveat added.
